```artifact
@start
  mode: IDLE
  initial: true

  mode Inspiration
    on Event INSPIRATION_DETECTED
      guard pressure < -4cm
      transition EXPIRATION

  mode Expiration
    on Event EXPIRED
      transition IDLE

@end
```
